title: RUST_CODE.BBS · The helicopter arrives
venue: Arthur's site · drawn during Message Boards · never posted
logline: The week the parody hits: the board's banner shows a new node, and on the desk a fifth stick figure the chorus didn't bring — the helicopter one, the one from the parody, spelled right in green over its head. The chorus moves away from it. Wood doesn't. The strip draws the desk divided.

panels.composition: The banner: the number up by one.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close on a green block banner on a screen with a two-digit number whose last shape has gone up

panels.composition: The desk: a new stick figure with a green word over it, longer than the others', and the three chorus figures at the desk's far edge.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a new tiny stick figure with a longer green block-word above it on a desk while three other tiny stick figures huddle at the desk's far edge

panels.composition: The new figure looking at WOOD. Wood looking back.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a tiny stick figure on a desk and a thin man looking at each other

panels.composition: The desk from above: the lamp's circle, the three at one edge, the one at the other, Wood's hand flat in the middle.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a desk seen from above under a lamp's circle with three tiny stick figures at one edge, one at the other, and a man's hand flat on the wood between them

art.line: digitized brush-pen on bristol; the stick figures in ballpoint; the screen as a gray rectangle with a banner in it
art.palette: muddy early-digital flats; the screen's phosphor green, once

notes: ROFLCOPTER, spelled right, in green. The desk divided. The parody week begins Nov 6 (canon).
